title: I. Of Faith in the Holy Trinity.

segments.text: THere is but one living and true GOD, everlaſting, without Body, Parts, or Paſſions; of infinite Power, Wiſdom, and Goodneſs; the Maker and Preſerver of all Things both viſible and inviſible. And in Unity of this Godhead, there be three Perſons, of one Subſtance, Power, and Eternity; the Father, Son, and the Holy Ghoſt.
